V1.hypothesis: With the 441-day CSZ rung fixed, dividing the 30-minute forward VWAP return by the realized volatility of the same prediction window (a Sharpe-style risk adjustment, applied before the timestamp cross-sectional z-score) improves the out-of-sample cross-sectional RankIC of the 1.32-point checkpoint on the development windows, relative to the same rung's three-seed baseline, by more than the pre-registered floor on a paired (window, trading day) basis, and improves it in at least seven of the ten windows.
V1.budget: inherited from the 441-day rung 1.32 point (max_train_samples=500000, component E)
V1.replay_after_training: screening pass: the eight screening windows, three seeds, equal 1/3 blend, same caliber; the two confirmation windows are replayed only after the captain's sign-off

baseline.label: control 3-seed equal blend at 1.32, same ten windows

development_windows.roles_authority_note: the captain's 2026-10-28 review declares jun2024/sep2024 the frozen confirmation windows; the file was not present in the repo copy at draft time, so the registration step must re-check it before those two windows are read
development_windows.confirmation_rule: read only with the captain's explicit release; never by the screening pass

caliber.blend: equal 1/3 mean of the three seed scores after inner merge on (date, instrument)
caliber.aggregation: pooled by trading day over the windows actually read

primary_criterion.estimator: paired by (window, trading day): candidate minus control baseline, pooled over all days read; the candidate blend and the control blend are formed from the same seeds and the same calendar, so every day is paired by construction

interval.method: corrected 5-day moving-block bootstrap of the pooled mean daily paired difference
interval.not_the_estimator: scripts/verify_b_release.py:97-99 block_indices draws starts from [0, n-block] without wrapping -- a different interval, not used here

screening_interval.note: the screening read uses n = 165 trading days -> 33 blocks; the registered ten-window test uses n = 203 -> 41 blocks; the same estimator function

accept.note: the registered gate is evaluated on all ten windows after the two confirmation windows are released; the screening pass reports the same statistics on the eight screening windows (165 days) as a pre-filter only, and does not change the thresholds

decided_by_user.why: validate_budget_points demands two strictly increasing points; 1.32 first keeps the full exposure guarantee and the 1.33 point is never scored

driver_anchor.rule: the scored point is the ten-window replay of the 1.32 weights; the second budget point is driver bookkeeping and is never scored or replayed
driver_anchor.intervention: kill the trajectory once the 1.32 point is exported (the recorded user preference), or let the negligible step-up point finish

exposure_contract.rule: run_training_trajectory reconciles every budget point: steps exact; |realised effective epochs - declared| <= atol; unique/usable coverage >= min_coverage; and when coverage >= 1.0 every training day must be fully covered
exposure_contract.why_unchanged: this arm keeps the rung's shuffle sampler, which feeds every usable row once per epoch, so coverage reaches 1.0 from the first >=1-epoch point on. The 0.99 floor in the captain's R1 plan comes from timestamp_grouped truncating group tails to a multiple of batch_size (21,904 of 3,521,680 rows); that does not apply here, so min_coverage stays at the rung's 1.0 -- the only arm-level guard that moves is none

steps.rule: steps = round(effective_epochs * usable_rows / batch_size), derived at run start
steps.note: a 21-step difference at the same measured usable_samples is under investigation; the driver prints the realised value at run start and the plan pins no count

factor.default_path_unchanged: label_vol_adjustment='none' (including the omitted key) leaves the label, data_sha256, window matrix, 5-step loss and checkpoint bit-identical to the current behaviour

definition.target: the official 30-minute forward VWAP return y (labels parquet column vwap_return)
definition.sigma: sigma = std of the 1-minute VWAP log returns of the sample's own forward window, ddof=0: vwap_m = bar amount / bar volume; r_k = log(vwap_m / vwap_{m-1}) on consecutive trading-clock minutes; the window of a sample at t is the trading-clock minutes t+1..t+30 (11:30 continues at 13:01 because the lunch break is not a return; the 09:30 sample has 29 such minutes because the first regular bar of the day is 09:31); a return exists only when both minutes traded
definition.order: official forward return -> divide by sigma -> timestamp cross-sectional z-score -> training-segment RMS match (model.target_centering=timestamp_zscore_train_rms_matched then model.target_scaling=train_std); the z-score is cross-sectional, so it must run after the volatility normalisation
definition.thin_window_fallback: fewer than 3 finite returns in the window (suspension or an extremely thin minute): use the same timestamp's cross-sectional median sigma, so the label row set never shrinks; on the development data this affects 0.02-0.13% of rows, whose true volatility is lower than the median, so their adjusted labels are slightly smaller than a full-window divisor would give
definition.inference_unchanged: the score path never reads the transform: the model still emits one (n,) score with the same key order, shape and _score chunking, so the submission path is unchanged

factor.row_set_invariant: same window, same seed: the valid-label row count and the row set (sorted by (date, instrument)) are identical to 'none'; the code asserts that every finite label row has a finite divisor
factor.known_direction: the thin-window fallback affects 0.02-0.13% of rows whose true volatility is below the timestamp median, so their adjusted labels are slightly smaller than a full-window divisor would give; the direction is known and recorded before scoring

arm_identity.rule: in realized_vol mode metadata.data_sha256 is UNCHANGED (the bar files and their digests do not depend on the label transform), so an arm is identified by recipe_sha256 plus metadata.label_vol_adjustment only
arm_identity.cannot_use: no comparison or replay script may use data_sha256 to decide whether two arms read the same data; two arms with equal data_sha256 may differ in labels
arm_identity.enforced_by: protocol.fair_data_pair accepts metadata.label_vol_adjustment as a factor-derived field and rejects any other data-identity difference

existing_tests.result: 53 failed / 779 passed / 7 skipped -- the same 53 failures on a pristine repo_featnorm copy, so pre-existing and not a regression

known_limitations: RankIC is not scale-invariant per timestamp when the divisor varies within the timestamp, so a gain may reflect the cross-sectional weight the divisor imposes rather than a better conditional mean; the report must state both readings

the thin-window fallback rescales 0.02-0.13% of rows by the timestamp median instead of their own volatility, so the direction of that subset's label error is known (slightly too small) but not corrected
the [1.32, 1.33] plan cannot be stopped exactly at the scored point without killing the process; the extra point costs ~1,100 steps (~2-4 min) and is never scored
the first run of each seed pays one extra bar read (~4-5 min) for the volatility windows; the registered cache_dir is reused and the frozen-h cache is never touched
data_sha256 does not distinguish the two arms; identity relies on recipe_sha256 and metadata.label_vol_adjustment
